name: prusactl
description: Run a Prusa 3D printer from an AI agent: status, camera, files, printing, and G-code.
long_description: Talks to the printer directly on your network through PrusaLink, and optionally through Prusa Connect (run `prusactl login` in a terminal) for the camera, on-screen dialogs, the print queue, and history. Unofficial; not affiliated with Prusa Research.

printer_address.title: Printer address
printer_address.description: IP address or hostname of the printer on your network (on the printer: Settings > Network). Leave empty if you ran `prusactl setup`.

printer_password.title: PrusaLink password
printer_password.description: On the printer: Settings > Network > PrusaLink (username maker).

camera_url.title: Camera RTSP address
camera_url.description: The Buddy3D camera's stream, rtsp://<camera-ip>/live, with no user or password. Needs ffmpeg installed where the app can find it. Leave empty to use Prusa Connect's snapshots.
